messages:
jen_support: Customer reports two ledger entries for a single user action; invoice shows duplicate token consumption. They attached two traces and a small ledger CSV. Escalating to infra.

samir_eng: Please paste raw request headers, body checksum, and model/region. Also any idempotency header?

jen_support: Provided info from customer (sanitized): model=redwood-medium-1, region=eu-central-1, traces trace/dpl-9001 and trace/dpl-9002. Ledger rows: 0xdef1  312 tokens\n0xdef2  312 tokens.

maya_billing: Billing ledger confirms two adjacent entries for same customer account about 800ms apart. No automatic crediting found.

olivia_sre: Quick hypothesis: client retried after perceived timeout and gateway forwarded both attempts because no Idempotency-Key header present.

ricardo_infra: Customer headers they sent (sanitized):\n```
POST /v1/completions
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***
X-Request-ID: 1793456701
User-Agent: acme/3.1.0
Content-Type: application/json
# No Idempotency-Key
```
The two traces show identical body sha256=0xdeadbeef and same X-Customer-ID: acme-prod-12.

ingress-proxy-bot: trace dpl-9001 -> forwarded to worker-04\ningress-proxy-bot: trace dpl-9002 -> forwarded to worker-11\ningress-proxy-bot: both forwards have same body-sha and identical content-length.

samir_eng: That matches a replay: client retried and gateway treated attempts as distinct because X-Request-ID changed. Our current dedupe only uses Idempotency-Key to avoid accidental suppression.

olivia_sre: Repro steps I ran in sandbox:\n1) open HTTP/2 multiplexed connection to gateway\n2) send request and kill downstream worker after request is accepted but before response bytes return\n3) acme-sdk retries automatically with new X-Request-ID\nOutcome: two backend forwards and two ledger entries.

ricardo_infra: Short-term options:\n- Enable conservative dedupe in gateway: if (body-sha + customer-id + route) match within 2s, suppress second forward and return cached response if present (FF gated).\n- Recommend SDK sets Idempotency-Key for idempotent requests and add SDK warning if missing.\n- Manual credit and ledger reconciliation script to find similar events.

maya_billing: For this account the invoice window shows +624 tokens; we can issue a manual credit for 312 tokens and create ticket BILL-5123. Assigning to finance-ops.

jen_support: Drafted customer reply: "We traced this to a client retry coupled with missing Idempotency-Key; issuing a 312-token credit and rolling out a mitigation." Sent and customer acknowledged. Asking legal? Likely OK for a small credit.

samir_eng: Long-term fixes: SDK auto-insert Idempotency-Key for retries of identical payloads, per-tenant gateway dedupe toggle, and a short reply-cache keyed by body-sha+customer TTL 5s. Also add metric for duplicate body-sha hits per customer.

devex_beth: I'll add docs snippet and SDK lint warning that alerts when no Idempotency-Key is detected for POSTs greater than 1s latency.

olivia_sre: I'll open a PR for FF-gated conservative dedupe. Target: canary in 48h, full rollout 2w after observed false positive rate small.

maya_billing: Created BILL-5123 and queued the credit. Also adding automation to scan for body-sha duplicates in last 30 days.

jen_support: Closing customer-facing ticket as resolved. Keeping this internal thread open until infra PR and billing scan complete. Thanks everyone.
